entries.title: Who Mahidhara is
entries.summary: Mahidhara S. (Mahi) is a Machine Learning Engineer and head of a 10-person unit at Digital Maven, Bangalore. He started as a data analyst, became an ML engineer and is moving into data science.
entries.details: He connects data, people and processes to turn messy business problems into measurable outcomes. Analyst by choice, operator by nature. He has worked with sales, operations, marketing, HR and the shop floor.

entries.title: What he is looking for
entries.summary: A data scientist role where the questions are still open: a team that wants someone who can frame the problem, build the model and get it used.
